page: Microsoft Azure F64ads_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Fadsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at a high frequency of 4.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB per core. For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 7559 GB NVMe SSD and is Premium Storage capable. No GPU accelerators are present on this instance.

Benchmark data places this server in the top tier for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng, as well as Passmark CPU and memory evaluations. The AMD processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 vector extensions, AVX_VNNI, and cryptography standards like AES and SHA_NI. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching top-tier read speeds of 11936.42 GB/sec for cached blocks and 416.51 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Database operations are robust, with Redis SET operations achieving 170.73 million operations per second and static web serving throughput reaching 99.57 GB/sec.

While the instance delivers top-tier performance for small and medium LLM inference tasks, its processing speed drops to average tiers when handling large 70B parameter models. The hardware profile is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring high-frequency CPU execution paired with dense, fast local NVMe storage without the overhead of a GPU. This configuration is optimal for high-throughput database operations, intensive web serving, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and compute-heavy applications that benefit from dedicated physical cores.
description: Microsoft Azure F64ads_v7 is a high-frequency, x86_64 architecture server instance from the Fadsv7 family, powered by a 64-core AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at 4.5 GHz. It features 256.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per core) and a bundled 7559 GB NVMe SSD, with no GPU accelerators. Operating on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance delivers top-tier performance in CPU benchmarks, memory bandwidth, and database operations, as demonstrated by 170.73 million Redis SET operations per second. While it excels at compute-heavy tasks and web serving, performance scales down to average levels for large-scale LLM inference. This server is highly suited for database hosting, multi-threaded data processing, and high-throughput web applications requiring fast local storage.
